title: K2 Space footer
description: A black footer: a large thin wide-set wordmark on the left and three plain columns (site links, social links, contact lines in groups) starting at the half, two thirds and five sixths of the width, set in 19px type at line-height 1.2; the copyright sits alone at the bottom right. Phones put the wordmark on top and the columns in a two-column grid. Links dim to 80% on hover.
notes: a column entry without href is plain text (an address line)
an empty group inside a column leaves a blank line
